newsitem.title: USA: U.S. mortgage application volume rose in latest week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. mortgage application volume rose in latest week.

text.p: The volume of U.S. mortgage applications rose 0.2 percent in the week ended April 11, according to a Mortgage Bankers Association of America weekly survey.
Specifically, the volume of applications to refinance mortgages fell 2.5 percent in the latest survey week, while applications to purchase mortgages increased 0.8 percent.
The seasonally adjusted refinancing index fell 2.5 percent to 285.1 from 292.3 the previous week.
The purchase index rose 1.3 percent to 176.3 in the latest survey from 174.0 in the previous week.
